entry.title: Version 1.0.9: crash-on-watch fixed; V patches retired
entry.summary: **Fixed: opening a channel could freeze on black or crash the app (Android).** The player created and released a whole media player per server while the video surface stayed attached to the first, already-released player — after a server fallback, a manual server hop or a side-player flip the picture was dead. 1.0.9 keeps one player per watch screen and swaps the stream inside it (`PlayerScreen.kt`), rebinds the surface on every flip, pauses on background, and only releases the player when you leave the screen.
